newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks soar at close on hopes of package.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks soar at close on hopes of package.

text.p: Pakistani stocks soared 2.45 percent at Wednesday's close on fresh buying triggered on hopes of a pro-business economic package to be announed shortly by Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif, dealers said.

"Expectations are high about the coming package which is likely to cut taxes and tarrif rates," said dealer Mohammad Iqbal. "Not only the active scrips rose today on the new accounts day buying, but the second tier scrips were also in demand."
The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index rose 38.86 points, to end at 1,627.33. Gainers beat losers 246 to 74.
Turnover rose to 55.57 million shares from 38.07 million on Tuesday.
Dewan Salman Fibre rose 1.15 rupees to 41.50, Hub Power 1.20 to 38.90, PTCL 0.45 to 30.90 and ICI Pakistan 0.25 to 24.45.
